the resonant production from an oscillating axion background is possible for fermions with spin 0 and 1/2.

the study of the resonant production from the vacuum of fermions with different spins or helicity by an oscillating axial field.

we obtain a complete description of the resonant production from an axial background, in the perturbative as well as non-perturbativeregime, for both massive and massless fermions.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the production of fermions is enhanced when the mass is small, as expected from the perturbative analysis.
the production of fermions with different helicities is not the same, as it was assumed in previous works.
the production of fermions can be enhanced by orders of magnitude when the axial field is massive.
